## Purpose
Define the first-time “Choose Your Hero” screen for Stronghold. Use the supplied Diablo Immortal-inspired UI reference for materials and framing, and the two supplied Arkodia character artworks for hero presentation.

Status: UI concept specification with source references and composed desktop and mobile mockups. Game implementation is not included.

## Visual direction
Use dark charcoal panels, aged gold gothic metal borders, ivory typography, restrained amber highlights, and a softly lit stone stronghold background. Keep decorative corners clear of text and touch targets. Preserve Arkodia’s own characters and emblems.

Carry the reference’s ornate portrait frames and circular skill medallions into hero selection. Combat HP, XP, timer, gold counters, joystick, and attack controls belong to battle; this screen focuses on choosing a hero.

### UI style reference
![Diablo Immortal-inspired Stronghold UI reference: aged gold gothic frames, dark panels, ivory labels, and circular skill icons](/api/rooms/DR2acdbf9c7c4af10516c89541/attachments/DA77a6f2fbadf4ac928b7e34b5)

## Screen composition
Design mobile portrait first, with the primary action visible above the device safe area.

| Area | Content |
|---|---|
| Header | “Choose Your Hero” with subtitle “Choose a hero to begin your journey.” |
| Main artwork | Large selected hero illustration, keeping the face and glowing gauntlet visible |
| Hero selector | Two portrait medallions labelled “Ember Warden” and “Rift Runner” |
| Hero details | Hero name, one short playstyle sentence, and starting skill |
| Starting loadout | Three circular skill slots: one starting skill and two empty slots |
| Footer | Primary button “Begin Journey” |

On wider screens, place hero selection and details beside the large illustration. Keep the same reading order and avoid stretching the portraits.

## Character artwork
Use these exact illustrations as the visual source. Preserve faces, outfits, weapons, and identifying colours. Use contained artwork or deliberate cropping that retains the face and gauntlet.

### Ember Warden
Amber coat, flowing brown hair, ivory shirt, and a glowing fire gauntlet. Use warm amber focus lighting.

Proposed UI description: “Wield flame to strike nearby foes.”
Starting skill: **Flame Fan — Lv. 1**.

![Ember Warden hero-selection artwork with amber coat and glowing fire gauntlet](/api/rooms/DRb4787514f3224844f3c207ab/attachments/DA883c30a0c603a3a2cd68a24c)

### Rift Runner
Deep teal coat, red scarf, ivory layers, and a cyan crystal gauntlet. Use cool cyan focus lighting.

Proposed UI description: “Strike enemies with rift energy.”
Starting skill: **Rift Bolt — Lv. 1**.

![Rift Runner hero-selection artwork with teal coat, red scarf, and cyan crystal gauntlet](/api/rooms/DRb4787514f3224844f3c207ab/attachments/DA7eb2061de2703716bd63deea)

## Selection and first-play flow
1. Open the hero selection screen before the first playable run.
2. Show both hero choices with equal prominence. Until a hero is selected, keep “Begin Journey” disabled and show “Select a hero to continue.”
3. Selecting a portrait updates the large artwork, name, description, and starting skill together. Indicate selection with a bright border, checkmark, and “Selected” label.
4. Show the starting loadout with Slot 1 populated at Lv. 1; Slots 2 and 3 show “Empty”.
5. Selecting “Begin Journey” confirms the highlighted hero and proceeds into the first run. Disable repeated submission while showing “Preparing your journey…”.

Selection alone must not begin the run. Keep both hero choices available before confirmation.

## Starting skill explanation
Use short helper copy:
“Skills cast automatically when enemies enter range.”
“Gain new skills through random level-up blessings.”

Only the default character skill is equipped at the start. Additional skills are acquired through blessings; do not imply that all three slots are available immediately or require manual combat buttons.

## Interaction and readability
- Minimum touch target: 44 × 44 CSS pixels.
- Keep text on solid or softly shaded panels rather than over faces or bright effects.
- Support keyboard focus, Enter/Space selection, and an accessible selected state.
- Communicate selection through text and a checkmark as well as colour.
- Keep transitions brief; respect reduced-motion settings.
- If artwork cannot load, retain the hero name, description, and usable selection control.
- All player-facing labels and documentation use English.

## Review checklist
- Gothic metal and gold framing follows the supplied UI reference.
- Both supplied character artworks are represented accurately.
- The selected hero, starting skill, and primary action are immediately clear on mobile.
- Three skill slots communicate one equipped skill and two empty slots.
- The player can change the selection before beginning.
- All three source images are embedded inline in this page.

## Desktop mockup

![Desktop hero selection concept with gothic gold framing, Ember Warden selected, Rift Runner portrait, starting skill and three-slot loadout](/api/rooms/DR2acdbf9c7c4af10516c89541/attachments/DA7d3c734296a0540b5b068eaa)

### Desktop layout
- Use a landscape 16:9 composition: hero selector on the left, selected hero artwork in the centre, and hero details on the right.
- Keep both hero portraits visible. Highlight the selected hero with a gold border, checkmark, and Selected label.
- Show one starting skill at Lv. 1 and exactly two Empty slots.
- Keep Begin Journey visible without scrolling and support Enter to confirm.
- Preserve the supplied character identities, aged gold gothic framing, charcoal surfaces, ivory text, and restrained amber lighting.

This image is a generated visual concept using the supplied UI and character references, not a screenshot of an implemented screen. Created with the built-in image generation tool. Prompt direction: landscape desktop Arkodia hero selection inspired by Diablo Immortal, preserving both reference characters, with a left portrait selector, central Ember Warden artwork, right starting-skill panel, three circular loadout slots, and Begin Journey action. All labels are English.

## Mobile mockup

![Mobile Choose Your Hero concept with Ember Warden selected, Rift Runner alternative, three starting loadout slots, and Begin Journey button](/api/rooms/DR2acdbf9c7c4af10516c89541/attachments/DA45c495c77dd35afba53902ac)

### Mobile layout
- Use a portrait composition with the selected hero artwork above two side-by-side hero portraits.
- Preserve the desktop concept’s aged gold gothic framing, charcoal panels, ivory typography, castle background, and red primary action.
- Indicate Ember Warden selection with a gold border, checkmark, and Selected label; keep Rift Runner available beside it.
- Show Flame Fan at Lv. 1 and exactly two Empty slots in a compact starting-loadout panel.
- Keep Begin Journey above the bottom safe area, with touch targets at least 44 × 44 CSS pixels. Scale the artwork to preserve the primary action on shorter screens.
- All interface labels are English.

This is a generated visual concept, not an implemented game screen. Created with the built-in image generation tool using the desktop mockup as a reference. Prompt direction: adapt Arkodia’s Diablo-inspired desktop hero selection to a portrait mobile screen, retaining both character identities, a large Ember Warden illustration, two selectable portraits, a three-slot starting loadout, and a full-width Begin Journey action.

## Rift Runner — Mobile mockup

![Mobile Choose Your Hero concept with Rift Runner selected, cyan crystal gauntlet, Rift Bolt at Lv. 1, two Empty slots, and Begin Journey](/api/rooms/DR2acdbf9c7c4af10516c89541/attachments/DA9dc30bf30371350e580e44c6)

- Portrait layout matching the Ember Warden mobile concept, with Rift Runner as the selected hero.
- Preserve the teal embroidered coat, red scarf, ivory layers, brown hair, and cyan crystal gauntlet from the supplied character artwork.
- Keep both hero portraits visible; mark Rift Runner with a gold border, checkmark, and Selected label.
- Starting loadout: Rift Bolt — Lv. 1, Empty, Empty. Keep Begin Journey visible above the bottom safe area.
- All interface labels are English.

## Rift Runner — Desktop mockup

![Desktop Choose Your Hero concept with Rift Runner selected, left hero selector, central Rift Runner artwork, and right skill and loadout panel](/api/rooms/DR2acdbf9c7c4af10516c89541/attachments/DA7e9b52c1e3f95b6aba03800d)

- Landscape 16:9 layout matching the existing desktop concept: selector on the left, selected hero in the centre, and details on the right.
- Highlight Rift Runner while retaining Ember Warden as an available alternative.
- Show Rift Bolt — Lv. 1 as the starting skill and exactly two Empty loadout slots.
- Preserve aged gold gothic framing, charcoal panels, ivory text, and the red Begin Journey action; use restrained cyan rift effects around the selected character.
- All interface labels are English.

Both images are visual concepts, not implemented game screens. Created with the built-in image generation tool. Prompt direction: use the existing mobile and desktop hero-selection mockups as layout references and the supplied Rift Runner illustration as the character reference; switch the selection, main artwork, description, and starting skill to Rift Runner while preserving the gothic UI and three-slot starting loadout.
